ValidationRule.description: Closed Lost Opty's can be cloned, but cannot be re opened
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Discovery") || ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Solicitation") || ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Committed") ) && ( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Withdrawn") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Excluded") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Cancelled") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Blood Drive Opportunity that is closed Lost/Won, cannot be re-opened
